dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: Just following orders from Sarge. If the enemy attacks, I have to report it straight away...

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: But I'm short-sighted, and... I'm still waiting on my new spectacles after I broke the last pair...

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: In the meantime... *sigh* Let's just hope it stays calm around here.
